turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
d is there a time window?

Hi! Yes — there’s a short cancellation window after an order is placed 🙂

Here’s how it works:

Under 45 minutes: you can cancel it yourself through your confirmation email using the “Edit or View your order” button
45 minutes to 1 hour: we may still be able to cancel it
After 1 hour: cancellation is no longer possible, even if the order still shows as unfulfilled

If you want me to check a specific order, send your order number and I’ll take a look.

What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?

Hi! Once an order has already shipped, it can’t be changed anymore. 💛

That means we can’t:

change the items
update the shipping address
cancel the order

If the package was sent to the wrong address and it’s too late to update, you can file a shipping claim here: claims.simplemodern.com

Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!

Once your order is canceled, the refund is processed right away on our end. turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail:
We’re not able to combine two separate orders into one shipment after they’ve been placed. 💛

If the orders are still very new, you may be able to cancel one or both and place a new single order instead:

within 45 minutes: use the “Edit or View your order” button in your confirmation email
45 minutes to 1 hour: cancellation may still be possible
after 1 hour: changes or cancellations usually aren’t possible

If you want, send your order number and I can help check the timing.

Will I get an email confirmation once the change is made?

Hi! Yes — if an order change is completed, you should receive an email update/confirmation. 🙂

A quick note:

if you make the change yourself through the “Edit or View your order” link, the update should be reflected by email
if our team makes a change manually, they’ll typically follow up by email as well

If you don’t see anything, check spam/junk just in case. Let me know if there’s anything else I can help with!
